description: This Dart source file defines the SupabaseConfig class, which manages configuration and initialization of the Supabase client within a Flutter project. It includes hardcoded configuration constants, URL normalization and validation logic, and an asynchronous initialization method to set up the Supabase client connection.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A class providing static methods and constants to configure and initialize the Supabase client, including URL validation, normalization, and connection status management.

methods.name: _normalizeUrl
methods.description: Normalizes the provided URL by trimming whitespace, ensuring the 'https://' prefix, and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: _validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the format of the Supabase URL, checking for correct scheme, domain, URI format, and host presence.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Supabase client with the hardcoded URL and key, performing validation, URL normalization, and connection status reporting. Ensures idempotency and supports concurrent calls.
